## Concurrent narration takes and a reliable latest release

`batch_process.py --phase takes` now requests all of a video's takes at the same time when the local voice REST service is running. local-voice-cloning v0.2.0 merges concurrent same-voice requests into one batched pass, which made three takes about 25% faster in its benchmark. An older service queues the requests as before. The CLI fallback still generates takes one at a time, because each call loads its own model. The take tests no longer depend on whether a voice service is running on the machine.

The release workflow now marks a tag as GitHub's latest release only when it is the highest version. Bootstrap pins the latest release, so an older tag that finishes publishing after a newer one can no longer become the default for new productions.

New productions automatically verify and pin this release. Existing productions keep their current snapshot.
